OUTLINE_SECTION_JSON.heading: Training
OUTLINE_SECTION_JSON.guidance: Cover STS-26 STEN training, parachute course at Ringway, finishing school at Beaulieu where applicable. Cite Guhnfeldt where the source supports it. Mark inferred dates explicitly.
body: Standard Linge course rotation: STS-26 → Ringway → Beaulieu.
